name: Drawer (web component)
summary: The drawer as a framework-free element, for pages that cannot load antd: a white panel that slides in from the right or left, or a full-width bottom sheet, with a title, a scrolling body, an optional footer and a dimmed mask.
highlights: Same look as the antd Drawer, no antd needed
Esc, mask and ✕ close it; focus trapped and returned
Right, left or bottom sheet with swipe to close
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-drawer>, that reproduces the antd Drawer as themed by drawerTheme value for value: the 378 wide white panel, the 16/24 header with a 16px SemiBold ink title and the shared dismiss ✕, the 24 padded scrolling body, the 8/16 footer, the dimmed mask and the 0.3s slide. It exists for pages that cannot take the antd Drawer: Vue 2 apps that only take <aha-*> elements, plain HTML pages and standalone demos, which used to draw the panel by hand. The antd Drawer stays the choice in React and Vue 3 apps that already load antd, and the choice for a plain top or bottom panel. A list-launched surface (one click on a deck or a file) is the bottom sheet, <aha-drawer placement="bottom">, in every framework: a grab handle, a 48px gap above it that closes on click, 16px top corners, swipe down to close, and a full page under 768px.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the render is identical in React, Vue and plain HTML. React (< 19) binds the `close` and `closed` events through a ref; Vue binds them natively. The element does not own its state: set or remove `open`, and call preventDefault() on `close` to keep it open. The bottom sheet has `slot="subtitle"` under the title and `slot="actions"` between the title and the ✕; the app owns the body layout and Previous / Next.

spec.label: Panel
spec.value: white (bg-elevated), 378 wide (size="large" 736, or width), full height, no radius, max 100% of its container; right edge by default, placement="left" mirrors it, placement="bottom" is the sheet below

spec.label: Bottom sheet
spec.value: placement="bottom": full width, top edge 48 below the viewport top (--aha-drawer-top-gap), top corners 16 (radius-xl), shadow mirrored upward, slides up over 0.3s; the gap is the mask, so a click on it closes unless `static`; under 768px it is a full page with no gap and no radius

spec.label: Handle
spec.value: bottom only: 40 × 4 pill (radius-pill) in the default border colour, centred 12 below the panel top, decorative (aria-hidden); kept at phone width

spec.label: Swipe
spec.value: bottom only, touch and pen: drag the handle or header down and the panel follows; release past 25% of its height or faster than 0.5 px/ms closes it (`close` source "swipe"), otherwise it snaps back, also when `close` is cancelled; the body scroll never starts it

spec.label: Header
spec.value: padding 16 24, 1px bottom rule in the split colour; title 16/1.5 SemiBold ink; the shared dismiss ✕ (tertiary icon-only xs aha-button, system-x 16) pinned to the title's first line, 8 from the title; optional slot="subtitle" under the title (14px secondary, outside the heading) and slot="actions" between the title and the ✕, both hidden when empty

spec.label: Body
spec.value: padding 24, scrolls on its own when taller than the panel, scroll does not chain to the page

spec.label: Footer
spec.value: slot="footer", padding 8 16, 1px top rule; hidden until something is slotted

spec.label: Mask
spec.value: the overlay colour (ink at 40%), fades in over 0.3s; a click closes unless `static`

spec.label: Shadow
spec.value: -6 0 16 0 ink 8%, -3 0 6 -4 ink 12%, -9 0 28 8 ink 5% (mirrored for the left edge); the antd drawer shadow

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: panel slides from its edge and fades .7 to 1 over 0.3s, mask fades over 0.3s; prefers-reduced-motion switches both off

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: role dialog, aria-modal, named by the title; traps Tab, locks page scroll, returns focus to whatever opened it; Esc, mask and ✕ emit a cancelable `close`; Esc and Tab leave an open popup inside the drawer (aria-expanded menus, aha-select, aha-dropdown, aha-menu, aha-popover) and an overlay portalled outside it to handle their own keys

props.name: open
props.desc: Shows the drawer. Removing it hides it and emits `closed`

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title. Fill `slot="title"` instead for rich content

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name; overrides the title as the name when both exist

props.name: placement
props.desc: The edge it slides from; bottom is the full-width sheet (width and size are ignored). Top is antd Drawer only. An unknown value falls back to right

props.name: width
props.desc: Panel width; a bare number is px. Wins over `size`

props.name: static
props.desc: A click on the mask does not close the drawer

props.name: contained
props.desc: Fills the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, keeps the trap; for a phone-sized frame

props.name: inline
props.desc: Static display inside a positioned ancestor: no trap, no scroll lock, no keys. For docs and previews

props.name: slot="subtitle"
props.desc: A line under the title, outside the heading ("10 slides · Updated 2 days ago"). Hidden when empty

props.name: slot="actions"
props.desc: Buttons between the title and the ✕ (Edit, Edit with AI, More). Hidden when empty

props.name: --aha-drawer-top-gap
props.desc: Bottom sheet only: the gap above the panel. Forced to 0 under 768px

props.name: close()
props.desc: Asks to close: emits `close`, closes unless cancelled

props.name: close
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. detail.source is escape, mask, close-button, swipe or method

whenToUse.when: a longer edit form or detail panel where page context matters, on a page that does not load antd: Vue 2 apps taking <aha-*>, plain HTML, standalone pages such as a report demo; also the bottom sheet that a click on an object in a list launches, in React, Vue 2 and Vue 3 alike
a React or Vue 3 app that already loads antd and wants a plain panel from the top or bottom edge (a list-launched sheet is <aha-drawer placement="bottom"> instead)
a short, blocking decision the user must complete first
the task is large enough to deserve its own route

opinion.note: Give it a heading and keep the primary action in the footer slot. Never hand-draw a drawer or a sheet with a fixed div: the trap, the scroll lock and the focus return come with the element. It is not a modal for audience phones; use <aha-audience-modal> there.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form: a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the inline, open example with the DS defaults.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-drawer[data-probe]');var r=el.shadowRoot;function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var p=cs(r.querySelector('.panel'));var h=cs(r.querySelector('.header'));var t=cs(r.querySelector('.title'));var b=cs(r.querySelector('.body'));var f=cs(r.querySelector('.footer'));var m=cs(r.querySelector('.mask'));return{surface:p.backgroundColor,width:p.width,radius:p.borderTopLeftRadius,headerPadTop:h.paddingTop,headerPadSide:h.paddingLeft,rule:h.borderBottomWidth,titleColor:t.color,titleSize:t.fontSize,titleWeight:t.fontWeight,bodyPad:b.paddingTop,bodyOverflow:b.overflowY,footerPadTop:f.paddingTop,footerPadSide:f.paddingLeft,mask:m.backgroundColor,role:r.querySelector('.panel').getAttribute('role'),modal:r.querySelector('.panel').getAttribute('aria-modal')};})()
